a1.instructionsIntro: For this assignment, you will demonstrate your understanding of core SEO concepts and how they apply to a real website or brand of your choice.
tasks: Define SEO in your own words and explain why it matters for businesses online.
Identify three on-page SEO factors and describe how each one affects search visibility.
Outline two ethical (white-hat) link-building strategies a small business could use.
Recommend one measurable KPI to track SEO success over the next 90 days.
submissionRequirements: Submission format: PDF or Word document (.pdf, .doc, .docx)
